Audience: every first-time Wisconsin Class D applicant, since every new driver meets school buses, emergency vehicles, bicyclists and large trucks.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the chapter sets the pedestrian, emergency vehicle, school bus and motorcycle rules [A01] and the bicycle passing distance and truck no-zones [A02].
Level: rule recall with a few exact distances and side-of-road conditions; light load.
Prerequisites: the basics sections on space, blind spots and passing, and the signals and lane controls section.
